style: A wide cinematic panoramic oil painting of a battle for a Tolkien-inspired fantasy strategy board game, painterly brushwork, rich but slightly muted earthy colours, dramatic natural light, atmospheric depth. Composition for a very wide and thin banner: the horizon, the place and the clashing armies lie in the middle third of the image height and stretch across the whole width; the top third is simple sky and the bottom third is simple foreground ground, both calm enough to be cropped away. The armies are seen from a distance as masses of small figures with spears, shields and banners; no close-up faces and no single hero in the foreground. An original scene, not resembling any film still. No text, letters, numbers, runes, logos, frame or border. Scene:

items.open-free-1: green rolling farmland and meadows of a free kingdom under a bright stormy sky; horsemen of men charge across the grass into an orc host, banners streaming.
items.open-free-2: open grassland at the edge of a pine forest beside a shallow river; shield walls of men and elven archers hold against a dark horde in golden afternoon light.
items.open-shadow-1: blasted plains of ash in a dark land, jagged black mountains behind and a dull red glow in the sky; orcs and dark men clash with armoured soldiers of the free peoples among smoking craters.
items.open-shadow-2: a barren grey wasteland with dead trees and pale sulphur pools under storm clouds lit red from below; a host of orcs and trolls meets a line of knights.
items.open-wild-1: wild rugged hills and heather moorland with rocky outcrops under low grey clouds; two armies skirmish across the moor, no houses anywhere.
items.open-wild-2: an untamed river valley with marshes, reeds and lone birch trees under morning mist; armies clash along the banks, no houses anywhere.
items.fortification-free-1: a ruined stone river crossing with broken bridge arches and earth ramparts; defenders hold the far bank while attackers wade the river under grey skies.
items.fortification-free-2: a fortified river ford with wooden palisades and two stone watchtowers on the banks; a battle rages at the crossing in amber dusk light.
items.town-free-1: a small village of thatched cottages and a timber hall among green fields and hedgerows; soldiers and militia defend it against raiders while smoke rises from one roof.
items.town-free-2: a hillside village of grey stone houses and a water mill beside a stream; fighting in the lanes and the fields around it under a windy sky.
items.town-shadow-1: a crude dark settlement of black tents, rough wooden huts and watch fires in a barren land; soldiers of the free peoples assault it at twilight.
items.town-shadow-2: a southern desert town of mud-brick houses, palm trees and red banners behind low walls in hot haze; armies fight around its walls.
items.city-free-1: a fair city of white stone with slender towers and blue banners behind high walls on a low hill; armies fight on the plain before its gates.
items.city-free-2: a city of great timber halls with golden roofs on a green hill above wide grassland; a cavalry battle sweeps across the slopes below it.
items.city-shadow-1: a grim city of dark stone with iron gates and windows glowing red behind black walls; siege towers and armies of the free peoples advance on it.
items.city-shadow-2: a sprawling southern port city of domed towers and red sails in its harbour; armies clash on the shore and the quays under a hazy sun.
items.stronghold-free-1: a mighty fortress built into a mountain gorge behind a great curved wall, torches on the battlements at night in the rain; a vast dark host attacks the wall.
items.stronghold-free-2: a great citadel of white stone with tiered walls climbing a mountainside; a vast besieging horde with siege engines covers the plain before it.
items.stronghold-shadow-1: a black fortress of jagged towers on a dark hill rising from a dead grey forest; besiegers under bright banners of the free peoples storm its slopes.
items.stronghold-shadow-2: a towering black iron fortress behind a huge gate set in volcanic mountains under a red sky; armies battle before its walls amid smoke and fire.
